drafts.title: Non-reckonable GHG: Sulphur hexafluoride
drafts.applies_to: Sulphur hexafluoride emitted in the course of manufacturing, installing, using or disposing of any electrical equipment
drafts.quote: Sulphur hexafluoride Emitted in the course of manufacturing, installing, using or disposing of any electrical equipment.

drafts.title: Non-reckonable GHG: Carbon dioxide (purging)
drafts.applies_to: Carbon dioxide used and emitted in the course of purging
drafts.quote: Carbon dioxide (a) Used and emitted in the course of purging.

drafts.title: Non-reckonable GHG: Carbon dioxide (blasting)
drafts.applies_to: Carbon dioxide used and emitted in the course of blasting
drafts.quote: Carbon dioxide (b) Used and emitted in the course of blasting.

drafts.title: Non-reckonable GHG: Carbon dioxide (lubricant or paraffin wax)
drafts.applies_to: Carbon dioxide emitted in the course of using any lubricant or paraffin wax
drafts.quote: Carbon dioxide (c) Emitted in the course of using any lubricant or paraffin wax.

drafts.title: Non-reckonable GHG: Carbon dioxide (combustion of biomass/biofuels)
drafts.applies_to: Carbon dioxide emitted in the combustion of biodiesels, biogasoline, charcoal, landfill gas, sludge gas, sulphite yes (Black Liquor), wood or wood waste, other biogas, other liquid biofuel, or other primary solid biomass
drafts.quote: Carbon dioxide (d) Emitted in the combustion of any of the following: (i) biodiesels; (ii) biogasoline; (iii) charcoal; (iv) landfill gas; (v) sludge gas; (vi) sulphite yes (Black Liquor); (vii) wood or wood waste; (viii) other biogas; (ix) other liquid biofuel; (x) other primary solid biomass.

drafts.title: Scope of HFC emissions for non-manufacturing refrigeration/AC
drafts.applies_to: Any hydrofluorocarbon emitted in the course of using any refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment for non-manufacturing purposes
drafts.quote: Any hydrofluorocarbon Emitted in the course of using any refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment for non-manufacturing purposes.

drafts.title: Scope of HFC emissions for specified hydrofluorocarbons
drafts.applies_to: The following hydrofluorocarbons: (a) HFC-227ca (b) HFC-245cb (c) HFC-245ea (d) HFC-245eb (e) HFC-263fb (f) HFC-272ca (g) HFC-329p (h) HFC-1132a (i) HFC-1141 (j) (Z)-HFC-1225ye (k) (E)-HFC-1225ye (l) (Z)-HFC-1234ze (m) HFC-1234yf (n) (E)-HFC-1234ze
drafts.quote: The following hydrofluorocarbons: (a) HFC-227ca (CF3CF2CHF2) (b) HFC-245cb (CF3CF2CH3) (c) HFC-245ea (CHF2CHFCHF2) (d) HFC-245eb (CH2FCHFCF3) (e) HFC-263fb (CH3CH2CF3) (f) HFC-272ca (CH3CF2CH3) (g) HFC-329p (CHF2CF2CF2CF3) (h) HFC-1132a(CH2=CF2) (i) HFC-1141(CH2=CHF) (j) (Z)-HFC-1225ye (CF3CF=CHF(Z)) (k) (E)-HFC-1225ye (CF3CF=CHF(E)) (l) (Z)-HFC-1234ze (CF3CH=CHF(Z)) (m) HFC-1234yf (CF3CF=CH2) (n) (E)-HFC-1234ze (trans-CF3CH=CHF)
